english: United for the struggle of independence
Let's hold up our heads, so long bowed

local: Et pour de bon prenons le plus bel élan,
english: And now, for good, let's keep advance boldly,
Oh ardent people, by hard work we shall build
Our country more beautiful than before, in peace

local: Nous bâtirons un pays plus beau qu'avant

english: Countrymen, we all sing the sacred hymn of your solidarity

local: Saluez l'emblème d'or de votre souveraineté
english: We shall populate your soil and ensure your eternal greatness
Thirtieth of June, oh eternal sun,
Thirtieth of June, thirtieth of June,
That we pass on to our future generation,
